newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schering may pay 2-mark divi for 1996 -chairman.
newsitem.headline: Schering may pay 2-mark divi for 1996 -chairman.

text.p: German pharmaceutical group Schering AG could pay a dividend of two marks per share on its 1996 results, up from 1.55 marks for 1995, management board chairman Giuseppe Vita said.
Vita also told German television in an interview that the company was expecting profit to increase by around 30 percent in 1996 from 1995, with sales up around 11 percent.

Schering surprised analysts with a stronger than expected 32 percent jump in its first half profits to 244 million marks ($161.9 million). Sales in the first half grew 11 percent to 2.6 billion marks. ($1=1.5070 Mark)
